# tree-sitter-markdown for MoonBit

Markdown grammar for tree-sitter.

This module packages [tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-markdown](https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-markdown) v0.5.4 for
[moonbit-community/treesitter](https://github.com/moonbit-community/treesitter), the pure MoonBit
port of Tree-sitter. The parse tables are generated from the grammar's
`src/grammar.json` by the port's generator, which produces the same tables
as `tree-sitter generate` 0.28.0. External scanners come from `@scanners.scanner_for` in
`moonbit-community/treesitter/scanners`, the MoonBit ports of the C scanners.

## API

The package mirrors the grammar's Rust binding (`bindings/rust/lib.rs`):

| MoonBit | Rust |
| --- | --- |
| `language() -> @treesitter.Language` | `LANGUAGE` |
| `inline_language() -> @treesitter.Language` | `INLINE_LANGUAGE` |
| `highlight_query_block : String` | `HIGHLIGHT_QUERY_BLOCK` (`tree-sitter-markdown/queries/highlights.scm`) |
| `injection_query_block : String` | `INJECTION_QUERY_BLOCK` (`tree-sitter-markdown/queries/injections.scm`) |
| `highlight_query_inline : String` | `HIGHLIGHT_QUERY_INLINE` (`tree-sitter-markdown-inline/queries/highlights.scm`) |
| `injection_query_inline : String` | `INJECTION_QUERY_INLINE` (`tree-sitter-markdown-inline/queries/injections.scm`) |
| `node_types_block : String` | `NODE_TYPES_BLOCK` (`tree-sitter-markdown/src/node-types.json`) |
| `node_types_inline : String` | `NODE_TYPES_INLINE` (`tree-sitter-markdown-inline/src/node-types.json`) |

## Usage

```sh
moon add moonbit-community/tree-sitter-markdown
```

In `moon.pkg`:

```text
import {
  "moonbit-community/treesitter",
  "moonbit-community/tree-sitter-markdown" @tree_sitter_markdown,
}
```

```mbt check
///|
test "parse markdown" {
  let language = @tree_sitter_markdown.language()
  let parser = @treesitter.Parser::new()
  parser.set_language(language)
  let source =
    #|| foo | bar |
    #|| --- | --- |
    #|| baz | bim |
    #|
  guard parser.parse(@utf8.encode(source)) is Some(tree) else {
    fail("parse failed")
  }
  let root = tree.root_node()
  assert_false(root.has_error())
  assert_false(root.to_sexp().contains("ERROR"))
}
```
